answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow unlock stops fake identities. An applicant locks 200 credits in escrow and shows a thread of verified work, tied to a non-transferable copper badge. A verifier checks the thread against tasks to unlock work. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 200 = 200,000 credits, while a reef of reputation grows only through real work. Renting a fingerprint slashes both parties. Honest agents pay once and earn undiluted rewards.
